metadata.reason_for_inclusion: Freeze the scope, authority, source-catalog, and autonomy deltas that triggered a required midflight audit.

trigger_delta: Expert classifications expanded from generic historical-doctrine research to periodized Jewish, ancient-context, philosophy, corpus, tradition, and verification facets.
Automatic role composition was added and therefore requires recursion, promotion, rights, budget, provider, and human-gate controls.
The existing campaign validator's HEAD-coupled source lock is stale even though source bytes replay, so this revision separates parent checkpoint identity from revision identity.
A named source catalog was added as candidate pointers only, creating a requirement for current source, edition, access, rights, and fitness verification before use.
Deterministic execution-presence proof was separated from independent substantive completeness review.
